notes: Each vector specifies (signer, options) inputs and the expected password output.
Vectors are language-agnostic and can be verified by any independent re-implementation.
Path A (wallet-imported): the 'signature' field is the fixed signature returned by the mock signer.
Path B (wallet-native): the 'userKey' field is the fixed 64-byte userKey returned by the mock signer.
expected.password values are computed by scripts/generate-vectors.mjs and checked by tests/test-vectors.test.ts, which recomputes every vector twice.

securityMode (optional, defaults to 'key-only' when absent): 'key-only' uses the signer alone; 'key-plus-secret' (the optional second-factor mode) mixes a 32-byte Secret Key into the base userKey via HKDF-SHA-256(IKM=baseUserKey, salt=secretKey, info='com.keptex.secretkey', L=64) before site-key derivation.
input.secretKeyHex (key-plus-secret only): the fixed 32-byte Secret Key, lower-case hex. Deterministic and hard-coded (byte[i] = (seed + i*step) & 0xff), never generated at random.

input.recoveryCode (optional): the canonical Crockford base32 recovery-code rendering of secretKeyHex (encodeRecoveryCode), included so independent implementations can verify the encode/decode round-trip.

vectors.name: stellar-basic-github-default-policy
vectors.description: Basic case: Stellar imported wallet, github.com, default policy

vectors.name: stellar-counter-rotation
vectors.description: Same Stellar wallet, same service, counter=2, must differ from counter=1

vectors.name: native-basic-github-default-policy
vectors.description: Keptex-native wallet (Path B), github.com, default policy

vectors.name: stellar-github-secretkey-A
vectors.description: key-plus-secret (second-factor mode): same Stellar wallet/service/username/counter as 'stellar-basic-github-default-policy', but mixed with fixed Secret Key A. Must differ from the key-only password.

vectors.name: stellar-github-secretkey-B
vectors.description: key-plus-secret (second-factor mode): identical signer/service/username/counter to 'stellar-github-secretkey-A' but a DIFFERENT fixed Secret Key B, proving the Secret Key alone changes the password.

vectors.name: native-github-secretkey-recovery-roundtrip
vectors.description: key-plus-secret (second-factor mode), Path B native signer, fixed Secret Key C with its canonical recovery code. Verifies encode(secretKey) == recoveryCode and decode(recoveryCode) == secretKey, then that the decoded key derives the expected password.
